message.content:
For \(g(x)=f(f(x))\), we need both:

1. \(x\) must be in the domain of \(f\), so  
\[
x \neq 3
\]

2. \(f(x)\) must be in the domain of \(f\), so  
\[
f(x) \neq 3
\]
Since
\[
f(x)=\frac{1}{x-3}
\]
we set
\[
\frac{1}{x-3}=3
\]
Solving:
\[
1=3(x-3)
\]
\[
1=3x-9
\]
\[
10=3x
\]
\[
x=\frac{10}{3}
\]

Thus the values not in the domain of \(g\) are:
\[
x=3,\quad x=\frac{10}{3}
\]

The largest of these is:
\[
\frac{10}{3}
\]

The answer is \(\frac{10}{3}\).
